_comment: Painted world map for the big map (Docs/Karte). Anchors: a place in the world (cm, X north, Y east) and where it lies on the painted picture (px of the 1024 picture). The map bends the world onto the picture through these points (thin plate spline), so the painted coast may differ from the terrain. Read by Scripts/CreateWorldMaps.py. Anchors with auto=true are written by Tools/Welt/Umriss/kuestenanker.ps1 (coast fit), do not edit by hand.
